data.one_liner: A customizable circular gauge-style pie chart widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: It renders a pie chart that can be displayed as a full or half circle, with adjustable gaps, start angle, colors, and optional text labels. The widget supports animation and a legend.
use_when: You need a simple gauge or progress indicator without heavy dependencies
You want a half-circle or full-circle pie chart with custom colors and labels
You prefer a single widget that handles layout and animation internally
avoid_when: You require advanced chart interactions like zoom or tooltips
You need a highly performant chart for large datasets
You are already using a comprehensive chart library like syncfusion_flutter_charts
strengths: Customizable gaps, start angle, colors, and text
weaknesses: No documentation on performance or large data handling
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_gauges
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a wider range of gauge types and more customization options

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a broader set of chart types and more advanced features

data.minimal_example:
GaugeChart(
  children: [
    PieData(value: 10, color: Colors.blue, description: "Taken"),
    PieData(value: 4, color: Colors.blue.shade300, description: "Planned"),
    PieData(value: 14, color: Colors.grey, description: "To plan"),
  ],
  gap: 3.5,
  animateDuration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
  start: 180,
  displayIndex: 2,
  shouldAnimate: true,
  animateFromEnd: false,
  isHalfChart: true,
  size: 200,
  showValue: false,
  borderWidth: 25,
)
